name: Sim0 Product Safety Info for WooCommerce
author: joesimo

sections.description:
The EU General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) asks online sellers to show certain product information on their listings, such as who made the product, who is responsible for it in the EU, how to identify it, and any warnings.

Sim0 Product Safety Info for WooCommerce gives you one place to enter that information and shows it to shoppers in a clean, readable Product safety tab on the product page.

Fields

  • Manufacturer name, postal address and electronic contact (email or website)
  • EU responsible person name, postal address and electronic contact
  • Product identifier (type, batch, model or serial number)
  • Warnings and safety information
  • Link to safety instructions or a document, for example a PDF in your media library

Features

  • Store-wide defaults: enter your manufacturer, EU responsible person and general warnings once, and every product shows them.
  • Per-product values on simple products: a Product safety tab in the product editor lets you override any default for one product. Grey placeholder text shows the default that will be used when a field is left empty.
  • A Product safety tab on the product page, grouped under Manufacturer, EU responsible person and Product identification and safety. The section is only added when there is something to show.
  • Email addresses become protected mailto links, websites and documents become links, and addresses keep their line breaks.
  • Works with classic themes and block themes that use the product details block.
  • Declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Clean uninstall: tick one setting and all values and settings are removed when you delete the plugin.
  • No tracking, no ads, no external requests. Translation ready.
  • Developer filters: psigpsr_fields, psigpsr_resolved_values, psigpsr_render_html and psigpsr_settings.

Variable, grouped and external products show the store defaults.

Important

This plugin helps you display product safety information. It is not legal advice and does not by itself make a store compliant with the GPSR or any other law. Check your obligations with a qualified advisor.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Sim0 Product Safety Info for WooCommerce”, then install and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product safety and fill in your store defaults.
  4. To override a value for one simple product, edit the product and open the Product safety tab in the Product data box.
sections.faq:
Where are the settings?

WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product safety.

Where does the information appear for shoppers?

In a Product safety tab next to the Description and Additional information tabs on the single product page. You can rename the tab in the settings.

Why don’t I see the tab on a product?

The tab only appears when at least one field has a value, either on the product or in the store defaults.

Can I set values for each variation of a variable product?

Not in this plugin. Variable products show the store defaults.

Does this make my store GPSR compliant?

No plugin can do that on its own. This plugin helps you collect and display the information. What you need to show depends on your products and your role, so check with a qualified advisor.

Does the plugin send any data anywhere?

No. It makes no external requests and does not track anything. All data stays in your WordPress database.

Is data removed when I delete the plugin?

Only if you tick “Remove data on uninstall” in the settings before deleting the plugin. This protects your data if you delete and reinstall.
